about_the_game:
"We don't pull mean pranks! We just have fun, that's all!"

Get the adorable Bratty Brother Bear costume, a vehicle, in-game currencies, and tools in one bundle at a low price! Enjoy life in Play Together with this Starter Pack that's jam-packed with must-have items!

Starter Pack - Bear Boy Contents:

  • Bratty Brother Bear Package

  • Classic Convertible (Green)

  • Amateur Rod

  • Rabbit Ear Bug Net

  • Toy Mallet

  • 100 Gems

  • 20,000 Stars

How to Claim Your Items:

  • Log in to the game and click on the "smartphone" icon located on the right side of the screen. Click on the "Inbox" icon at the bottom.

  • Press the "Receive" button to collect the contents of the DLC pack.

※ This DLC product will be delivered to your Inbox immediately upon purchase. Please make sure to check the product before making a purchase as it includes non-refundable consumable items.
